topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I was sitting in the quiet corner of the library, lost in a chapter of my textbook when my phone buzzed. It was an email from the academic integrity office, requesting a meeting. They mentioned something about an allegation. I read through the email again, trying to make sense of it. My eyes kept lingering on the word "plagiarism." I’ve always been meticulous with my citations, double-checking everything. The thought of any error, any misunderstanding, was unsettling. I couldn’t help but replay my last assignment in my head, wondering where I might have gone wrong. The librarian's announcement for closing time seemed to echo in the silence around me.
